method: Compared each changed paragraph against the original source, read surrounding branch procedures, output table, seven principles, appetite lists and final rules. Independent reviewer separately checked the condition correction.

findings.original: no container unless a coherent actionable outcome, in which case an outcome-named project is proposed
findings.candidate: propose only when the outcome qualifies
findings.issue: Only when preserves the restriction but leaves the positive proposal obligation implicit.
findings.resolution: Positive if branch now requires the proposal; otherwise explicitly propose no container.
